preamble.summary: Psalm 104 — the great creation psalm. Multiple Qumran manuscripts preserve it. 11QPsᵃ places Psalm 104 between Pss 118 and 147 in its alternative ordering.
preamble.notable_variants: 11QPsᵃ ordering: Ps 104 follows 118. No significant content variants. Minor orthographic variation only (the standard Qumran plene-spelling tendency).
preamble.scroll_condition: Fragmentary attestation; no continuous DSS coverage.
